values.note: Non-electric overflow sites $20, water/electric sites $25. The county has announced 2027 fees of $26 non-electric and $34 electric. $10 cancellation fee (48 hours ahead); from 2027, $25 when cancelled under 10 days out.

'#11') + https://www.playfranklincounty.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/Jamison-Mill-Park-10 ('Beginning in 2027 campground fees will increase to: Electric sites: $34.00 and nonelectric sites will be $26.00.'; 'There is a $10.00 fee for cancelations')

values.note: Reserved and paid online through Franklin County Parks & Recreation's ActiveNet page (or 540-483-9293). The receipt carries the gate and bathhouse access code that entry requires, and the county asks campers to reserve before arriving because cell reception at the park is extremely weak; it does not mention walk-up camping.

values.note: Water/electric sites 1-5 beside the bathhouse; non-electric overflow sites 6-11 away from it. 'Trailers longer than 30 feet are not recommended due to small sites.' Up to six people and two tents per site; extra vehicles park in the main lot.

note: Franklin County Parks & Recreation campground on Corps of Engineers land at Philpott Lake, near Henry. Wooded lakeside setting with a non-motorized boat ramp and hiking trails; the electric sites sit beside the bathhouse, the overflow sites away from it. Cell reception is extremely weak. --Claude
summary: Read Franklin County Parks & Recreation's own page and its ActiveNet booking search: changed sites 19 -> 11 (max 30 ft), booking reservable false/fcfs always -> reservable online (fcfs cleared), added $20 non-electric / $25 electric (2026; 2027 $26/$34), season Apr 1-Oct 31, water hookups at sites 1-5, showers/drinking water/dump. Not stated: electric amperage, sewer. Note rewritten (the 'no hookups', 'first-come' and site-count text was wrong).
flags: Ownership class: the Corps' Philpott firearms-zone map (https://www.saw.usace.army.mil/Portals/59/docs/recreation/philpottlake/final%20-%20Philpott%20FSI%20Map%202020.pdf) lists 'Jamison Mill Park - Franklin County: 540-483-9392', and Franklin County Parks & Recreation runs and books the campground (https://www.playfranklincounty.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/Jamison-Mill-Park-10). It is a county-operated lease on USACE land, so ownership should probably be local (with policy_ref none or a county row), not federal; the inherited federal booking/discount rows (recreation.gov, America the Beautiful) don't apply.
Phone: 276-629-2703 is the USACE Philpott Lake office; the campground's operator is Franklin County Parks & Recreation, 540-483-9293 (its page and reservation contact).

Missing operator website: the county's page is https://www.playfranklincounty.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/Jamison-Mill-Park-10 (booking https://anc.apm.activecommunities.com/fcpr/reservation/landing/search?eventTypeIds=11); the entry's website is the Corps' general Philpott recreation page, which does not mention Jamison Mill.
Hookups: the county says sites 1-5 have water/electric but gives no amperage, so electric was left unset; a search for electric will not find this campground until someone confirms the amps.
